name: Vidisha

queries.query: Vidisha Madhya Pradesh official cadastral map GIS parcel map
queries.result: Official Vidisha district Land Records page identifies Madhya Pradesh Revenue Department Land Records as the custodian, says it maintains land records including survey numbers, and links the public WebGIS 2.0 portal. Government of India DILRMP also exposes Vidisha district/tehsil map digitization and georeferencing status.

queries.query: विदिशा भू नक्शा मध्य प्रदेश आधिकारिक cadastral map
queries.result: Hindi official Vidisha district Land Records page repeats that the Madhya Pradesh Revenue Department maintains land records and directs users to WebGIS 2.0 at webgis2.mpbhulekh.gov.in. The public service search result describes online parcel-map access by district, subdivision, tehsil, and village.

officialAndRelevantLeads.operator: District Vidisha, Government of Madhya Pradesh; Revenue Department Land Records
officialAndRelevantLeads.observation: Official district page states that Madhya Pradesh Revenue Department Land Records maintains land records including survey numbers and links WebGIS 2.0.

officialAndRelevantLeads.operator: Government of India, Department of Land Resources, DILRMP
officialAndRelevantLeads.scope: National status dashboard, not the parcel-serving local registry
officialAndRelevantLeads.observation: Vidisha district dashboard lists Vidisha tehsil with 656 villages, 235 digitized/georeferenced map units, 124677 total land parcels, 110369 georeferenced parcels, and Bhu-Naksha use. This establishes reported coverage status, not a retrievable parcel response for the WUP point.
